label: INBOX

messages.subject: URGENT: Meridian Textiles escalation — recovery plan by Wednesday
messages.label: INBOX
messages.body: Ravi, Meridian's supply chain head called again this morning about consignment HYD-88214. They are pressing for the recovery plan before Wednesday and hinted at the SLA penalty clause. I need your draft by tomorrow evening so I can review before it goes out. Please prioritise this over the vendor review follow-ups. — Priya

messages.subject: Invitation: Festival surge planning kickoff — Thu Jul 9, 11:00 IST
messages.label: INBOX
messages.body: You are invited to the festival surge planning kickoff meeting on Thursday, July 9 at 11:00 IST in the Godavari conference room. Agenda: Visakhapatnam warehouse capacity, 3PL rate cards, guarantee program pilot scope. Organiser: Arjun Rao. Please confirm attendance.

messages.subject: Re: Missed pickups on Hyderabad-Chennai lane
messages.label: INBOX
messages.body: Dear Ravi garu, further to our call, we acknowledge the fourteen missed pickups in May and the pending consignment HYD-88251. Our dedicated fleet proposal is attached for your review. We request a meeting next week to discuss the performance improvement plan terms. Regards, Venkat, Sagar Roadlines.

messages.subject: GST re-verification for Meridian bookings — done for 11 of 14
messages.label: INBOX
messages.body: Ravi, update on the action item from Monday's sync: carrier GST details re-verified for 11 of 14 Meridian bookings. The remaining three have mismatched transporter IDs and I've raised tickets with the carriers. Will close all by Tuesday EOD as committed. One request: can you approve the Sunday pre-verification shift roster today so Suresh can staff it for July 12?

Also — the toll interchange issue repeated yesterday with two Eastern Cargo vehicles; suggest we add the standing e-way bill audit to Thursday's agenda.

messages.label: INBOX
messages.body: Ravi, the board pre-read goes out Friday morning. I want two slides from the Q2 vendor review: the Sagar Roadlines risk with your recommendation, and the Krishna Transport concentration question. Keep it crisp. Send me your draft by Thursday noon. — Madhavi
